name: Aditya-L1
mission: Study of the solar corona and solar wind
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Observes the Sun’s outer atmosphere and measures particles and magnetic fields to help study solar activity.

name: Parker Solar Probe
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Flies through the Sun’s outer atmosphere to investigate how the corona is heated and the solar wind accelerates.

name: Solar Orbiter
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Combines remote images and local particle measurements to connect activity on the Sun with the surrounding heliosphere.

name: SOHO
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Studies the solar interior, atmosphere, and wind. Its coronagraph observations also reveal many Sun-grazing comets.

name: Solar Dynamics Observatory
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Observes the solar atmosphere and magnetic field to investigate how solar activity develops and affects space weather.

name: Hinode
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Uses optical, X-ray, and ultraviolet instruments to study the connection between solar magnetic fields and the corona.

name: James Webb Space Telescope
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Observes infrared light from early galaxies, forming stars, and exoplanet atmospheres using a segmented primary mirror.

name: Hubble Space Telescope
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Studies planets, stars, and galaxies above Earth’s atmosphere, building a long observational record of the universe.

name: Chandra X-ray Observatory
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Observes X-rays from hot gas, stellar remnants, and material near black holes to investigate energetic cosmic processes.

name: XMM-Newton
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Collects X-rays to study black holes, galaxy clusters, and other hot or energetic objects across the universe.

name: TESS
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.

name: Euclid
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Maps galaxy shapes and distances to investigate the large-scale structure of the universe and its expansion history.

name: Chandrayaan-3

name: Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Carries instruments for studying the Moon’s surface, composition, and exosphere. This catalogue entry refers to the orbiter component.

name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Maps the lunar surface and measures the Moon’s environment to support scientific investigation and future exploration.

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Images the Martian surface, studies minerals and weather, and serves as a communications relay for surface missions.

name: Mars Express
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Studies Martian geology, atmospheric processes, and the subsurface with cameras, spectrometers, and radar.

name: MAVEN
statusBasis: Historical mission; NASA reports the mission ended following the loss of signal in December 2025.
description: Studied the solar wind’s interaction with Mars’s upper atmosphere and the escape of atmospheric gases. NASA has declared the mission ended.

name: Juno
statusBasis: Active in the demo catalogue; real operational status is not verified.
description: Studies Jupiter’s gravity, magnetic field, atmosphere, and auroras to investigate the giant planet’s structure and origin.

name: BepiColombo

name: JUICE

name: Cassini

name: Terra
